subject: Reschedule request — cross-region demo (proposed split sessions to avoid Golden Week & EU bank holidays)
messages:
From: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@astramed.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: AstraMed IT <it@astramed.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Feb 2026 10:12:00 +05:30
Subject: Request to move May 1 demo (regional conflicts)

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for scheduling the product walkthrough — the team is excited. A quick flag: the tentative May 1 slot you sent runs smack into Golden Week coverage for our Japan office (most of them are OOO Apr 29–May 5). Separately, our UK and Germany leads are out for early-April bank holidays (Easter week), so we're worried the suggested April/May windows will leave at least one region excluded.

Can we look at alternatives that avoid: (a) Japan Golden Week (late Apr/early May), (b) EU Easter bank holiday (first week of April), and (c) the US spring DST change — it shifts US availability by an hour in early March and complicates multi-region coordination. We want a single live session if possible but would be fine splitting into two short regional-friendly windows to get all stakeholders live.

Appreciate a few concrete options and we'll confirm availability from our side.

Best,
Emily
Emily Zhou
Head of Clinical Platforms, AstraMed
emily.zhou@astramed.com
+91 98X-XXX-XXXX

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@astramed.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Feb 2026 11:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request to move May 1 demo (regional conflicts)

Hi Emily — thanks for the heads-up and the availability CSV. Good call to avoid a single one-size-fits-all time that leaves a region in the dark. I'm looping in Vanessa (AMER/EMEA scheduling) and Logan (solutions engineer) so we can propose workable windows.

Quick proposal (attached ICS + MAP):

Option A — Two short live sessions (recommended)
- APAC/AP: 2026-04-30 02:00–02:45 UTC (mid-morning JST / late afternoon PT previous day) — covers Japan pre-Golden Week overlap; short Q&A.
- EMEA/AMER: 2026-05-05 13:00–13:45 UTC (late morning CET / early morning PT) — compact session timed after EU bank holidays and just outside peak Golden Week window.

Option B — Single compact window (90 minutes)
- 2026-05-04 12:00–13:30 UTC — one session but will be early for Japan and late for US West; risk of partial attendance.

Operational notes:
- US DST: Spring forward happens 2026-03-08 — if we shift dates into mid-March, US local times move +1 hour; we called out UTC above to avoid ambiguity.
- Recordings & async Q&A: we'll record both sessions and provide a short follow-up office hours window if needed.

I've attached a quick MAP (mutual action plan) with milestones and dependencies (MAP_AstraMed_v1.pdf) and an .ics with the proposed windows so you can drop them into your calendar. If two sessions work, we can run the same 20-minute demo + 25-minute Q&A format twice to keep it tight.

Please let us know which option you prefer and any strict blackout dates for your leads; once confirmed we'll send calendar invites and ask your IT to whitelist redwood-internal accounts if the demo includes live data connectors.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Natarajan
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0138

[attachments: proposed-demo-windows.ics, MAP_AstraMed_v1.pdf]

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Feb 2026 12:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request to move May 1 demo (regional conflicts)

Priya — quick preference note from the engineering side: Option A is cleaner. Two short, focused sessions reduce the follow-up load and let us tailor the demo surface area (APAC gets specific JP/SEA connector notes; EMEA/AMER gets compliance & infra detail).

Also adding an ops note: Japan's Golden Week typically has staggered team OOO dates; we should aim to avoid Apr 29–May 3 if we want core JP presence. For EU, avoid April 2–6 (Easter week) where possible.

I'll prepare a 3-slide appendix for the APAC session covering international timezone-friendly config and caching/quantization profiles (to reduce token costs during the demo).

—Logan

From: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@astramed.com>

Cc: AstraMed IT <it@astramed.com>

Thanks — Option A works for us. Confirming APAC session on 2026-04-30 02:00–02:45 UTC and EMEA/AMER on 2026-05-05 13:00–13:45 UTC. Our JP office will join the Apr 30 slot (they'll be available early morning JST) and EMEA will join the May 5 slot.

Please send calendar invites and the recording link after the sessions. Also flagging (for future planning) that our India product leads are blocked during late October/early November for Diwali — worth avoiding big new rollouts then.

Appreciate the flexibility — Emily
